title: Orbitlytics Daily Standup - API Rate Limiting Rollout

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Morning everyone. Let's do a quick round on the rate limiting rollout before we break out.

transcript.speaker: Jae-won Lee
transcript.text: Backend's done - the token bucket limiter is live on staging and response headers now include X-RateLimit-Remaining.

transcript.speaker: Jae-won Lee
transcript.text: One thing - when a client gets throttled we just return a bare 429 with no body. Sofia, does the frontend handle that gracefully right now?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Marchetti
transcript.text: Not yet, it just shows the generic 'something went wrong' toast. I can add a proper message, something like 'You're making requests too quickly, please slow down,' but I'll need the retry-after header wired up too.

transcript.speaker: Jae-won Lee
transcript.text: It's already in the response headers, Retry-After in seconds. I'll add it to the docs today.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Marchetti
transcript.text: Great, I'll pick that up this afternoon and have the friendly error message ready by tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Tomasz Kowalski
transcript.text: Mostly green. There's one flaky test in the checkout integration suite - about one in five runs it times out waiting for the cart total to update. Not sure yet if it's related to the rate limiter or a pre-existing race condition.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Let's not block the rollout on that if it's unrelated, but can you dig into it today so we know which bucket it's in?

transcript.speaker: Tomasz Kowalski
transcript.text: Yeah, I'll investigate today and report back.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Okay. If staging holds up over the weekend with no new issues, let's roll this out to production early next week, Monday or Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Marchetti
transcript.text: One open question - should the rate limit threshold be configurable per API key tier? Some of our enterprise customers are going to hit the default limit fast.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Good question, I don't have an answer yet - let's raise it with Derek and figure it out before enterprise customers start complaining. For now the default ships as-is.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nandakumar
transcript.text: Alright, that's it for today. Thanks everyone.

summary_key_points: Rate limiting is live on staging with Retry-After headers
Frontend will add a friendlier error message for throttled requests
QA is investigating a flaky checkout integration test
Production rollout is planned for early next week if staging holds

action_items.task: Add a friendly rate-limit error message using the Retry-After header
Document the Retry-After header for the frontend team
Investigate the flaky checkout integration test

decisions: Roll out rate limiting to production early next week if staging holds over the weekend
open_questions: Should the rate limit threshold be configurable per API key tier for enterprise customers?
